THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act.

An Allotment of land depicted in the Advance Tracing No. Ya/TLL/2018/42 dated 30.04.2019 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village called Varuttalaivilan in the Grama Niladari Division of Kurumbasiddy East, Div. No:J/243 in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Valikamam North in Jaffna District of Nrothern Province and bounded as follows:
